query: How do we remediate fatal panic ERR-PG-9042-WAL on standby nodes?
gold_answer: Stop standby replay, run pg_waldump on the corrupted timeline segment, and re-fetch the archived WAL segment from object storage before restarting recovery.

regime_a_intact.content:
### Runbook: ERR-PG-9042-WAL (Standby WAL Segment Checksum Panic)
Remediation: Pause standby recovery, verify segment integrity via pg_waldump, and restore the damaged WAL file from cold archive before resuming replication.

### Runbook: ERR-PG-7710-LOCK (Standby Lightweight Lock Starvation on WAL Replay)
Remediation: Fatal panic on standby nodes during high-concurrency WAL replay. Increase max_locks_per_transaction=256 and set max_standby_streaming_delay=30s.
